proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ s A B C D hA hB hC hD
  have key : ∀ X Y : P, X ∈ s → Y ∈ s → dist (midpoint ℝ X Y) s.center ^ 2 + (dist X Y / 2) ^ 2 = s.radius ^ 2 := by
    intro X Y hX hY
    have hA' : ‖X -ᵥ s.center‖ = s.radius := by rw [← dist_eq_norm_vsub V]; exact hX
    have hB' : ‖Y -ᵥ s.center‖ = s.radius := by rw [← dist_eq_norm_vsub V]; exact hY
    have hm : midpoint ℝ X Y -ᵥ s.center = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((X -ᵥ s.center) + (Y -ᵥ s.center)) := by
      rw [midpoint_vsub, smul_add]; simp
    rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V (midpoint ℝ X Y), dist_eq_norm_vsub V X Y, hm, ← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right X Y s.center, norm_smul]
    have hp := parallelogram_law_with_norm ℝ (X -ᵥ s.center) (Y -ᵥ s.center)
    rw [hA', hB', vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right] at hp
    norm_num
    nlinarith
  have h1 := key A B hA hB
  have h2 := key C D hC hD
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [h] at h1
    have : dist (midpoint ℝ A B) s.center ^ 2 = dist (midpoint ℝ C D) s.center ^ 2 := by linarith
    exact (sq_eq_sq₀ dist_nonneg dist_nonneg).mp this
  · intro h
    rw [h] at h1
    have : (dist A B / 2) ^ 2 = (dist C D / 2) ^ 2 := by linarith
    have := (sq_eq_sq₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).mp this
    linarith
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (A B C D : P), A ∈ s → B ∈ s → C ∈ s → D ∈ s → (dist A B = dist C D ↔ dist (midpoint ℝ A B) s.center = dist (midpoint ℝ C D) s.center)
